# IWMMD 1.2.0

IWMMD 1.2.0 improves notification email, fixes label overlap in the expiry horizon, and makes audit actors easier to identify.

## Email templates

- New responsive HTML email layout with branded header, status pill, fact rows, and one action button.
- Plain-text fallback remains for clients that do not render HTML.
- The body no longer repeats the subject or the same incident text.
- Expiry, incident-open, incident-recovery, and test emails use matching status styling.
- All domain-provided values are escaped before rendering.

## Expiry horizon

- Increased marker lane spacing.
- Connector lines now render behind labels.
- Dots no longer sit on top of label cards or cover text.

## Audit log

- Audit entries include actor email and display name.
- The audit log shows the full actor user ID, display name, and email.
- The Users tab shows each user's full ID so audit actors can be matched without developer tools.

## Upgrade from 1.1.2

There is no database migration. Stop IWMMD, replace the container image or binary, and start it again.

This release includes the 1.1.2 trusted-proxy fix.

Container users:

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.2.0
```

Set `IWMMD_IMAGE=ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.2.0` in `.env` to pin the release.

Binary users:

```sh
curl -LO https://github.com/MrWeez/iwmmd/releases/download/v1.2.0/iwmmd_1.2.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
tar -xzf iwmmd_1.2.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
sudo install -m 0755 iwmmd_1.2.0_linux_amd64/iwmmd /usr/local/bin/iwmmd
iwmmd version
```

Replace `amd64` with `arm64` on ARM servers.

## Release assets

| Asset | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `iwmmd_1.2.0_linux_amd64` | Raw static binary for x86-64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.2.0_linux_arm64` | Raw static binary for ARM64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.2.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz` | Binary and license for x86-64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.2.0_linux_arm64.tar.gz` | Binary and license for ARM64 Linux |
| `checksums.txt` | SHA-256 checksums for all binary assets |

Verify downloaded assets:

```sh
sha256sum -c --ignore-missing checksums.txt
```

## Container image

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.2.0
```

Published image tags: `1.2.0`, `1.2`, `1`, `latest`, and `sha-<commit>`.
